record_title: Exact phase geometry and critical logarithmic spiral in symmetric Lorenz-84
provenance: Exact complex-coordinate phase reconstruction, Lyapunov analysis of the symmetric Lorenz-84 reduction, and sharp critical asymptotics.
limitations: Restricted to zero asymmetric forcing G=0. Global isochrons require autonomous F>1; critical asymptotics require autonomous F=1 and exclude the invariant axis where phase is undefined. Older theses and early Lorenz-84 papers leave residual priority risk; originality is to the best of our knowledge.
